nodes.label: Spark.vert
nodes.rationale: Entirely GPU-side particle vertex shader: every spark's spawn, rise, drift, stretch and shrink is a closed-form function of time and a baked-in per-spark seed.

nodes.label: GPU-only closed-form particle system
nodes.rationale: There is no CPU particle system and no per-particle uniform data: each spark's whole lifecycle is a function of time and a baked-in seed, looping forever via fract().

nodes.label: hash11 (Dave Hoskins 1D hash)
nodes.rationale: Three fract/multiply rounds decorrelate the several quantities derived from one inSeed (spawn x/y, drift sign/amount, streak length) so they don't all covary with the seed.

nodes.label: Crown spawn tracking the height envelope
nodes.rationale: Sparks spawn across the flame's crown, not the wick, and the whole center is scaled by heightScale so a guttering flame's sparks spawn lower instead of popping out of empty air.

nodes.label: Age-dependent drift (t*t) and noise wobble
nodes.rationale: Drift grows as t*t so a spark barely wanders right after being thrown off and curls away as it cools; a time-sampled noise walk whose amplitude grows with age keeps the path from being one clean parabola.

nodes.label: Velocity-aligned streak stretch
nodes.rationale: travelDir is the derivative of the same center curve (not an independent value) and the quad is stretched 2.5-4x along it, so a young spark points straight up and tilts as it ages.

nodes.label: Raw corner passthrough gives a free elliptical falloff
nodes.rationale: Because the stretch is an affine map of inCorner, interpolating the raw corner across the stretched quad still lines up, so a plain circular falloff on quv reads as an ellipse and the stretch factor never needs to reach the fragment shader.

nodes.label: Per-spark intensity gate as a fake spawn rate
nodes.rationale: With a baked-in spark count there is no dynamic spawn rate, so each spark gets a threshold (0.45..1.15) that the flame envelope (0.30..1.40) gates on; the dimmest ~40% always burn and the rest arrive as bursts, and a gated-off spark collapses to a degenerate quad costing no fragment work.
